description: Get the most recent ZK email recovery request snapshot for an account. Returns hasActiveRecovery: false when no recovery exists or the latest is in a terminal state (cancelled/completed/expired); otherwise returns recovery details including approved/pending recovery emails (anonymized as a***@domain) and time until executable. Reads from DB only — agents tolerate the slight lag while the cron syncs on-chain state.

accountId.description: Account UUID. Defaults to the user's main LOCAL account when omitted.

name: get_recovery_status
